notes.title: Out Now: SHIFT87 - Hunt Anomalies in this REVEIL Spin-Off
notes.content:
Dear REVEIL players,

today we have great news for all of you who are in the mood for another psychological experience set in the REVEIL universe. Our observation horror game "[b]SHIFT87[/b]" is [b]OUT NOW![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2981650/Shift_87/

[list]
[*]Shift87 might provide you with a completely different perspective on REVEIL. 
[*]Subtle anomalies and disturbing events await you. 
[*]Your task in SHIFT87: Memorize your surroundings and report anomalies. 
[*]If this sounds intriguing to you, let's start your first shift. Don't be afraid...
[/list]

Official SHIFT87 trailer: 

[previewyoutube=iea6ji7a8Rk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Shift 87[/b] is a first person observation horror game.
Keen investigators can find a total of [b]66 anomalies[/b] throughout [b]3 levels[/b] of handcrafted, highly atmospheric environments.

Runs are randomly generated, featuring small and subtle as well as horrifying and unmissable anomalies to provide a gameplay experience that is uniquely different and exciting each time. Players can expect a playtime of around 2-3 hours for a full playthrough.

[i]Can you find and report all of them to end your shift?
Or will terrible paranoia be your downfall...?[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbWIwbHRrMzBnb3M5ZGJxbDYxeHNodmQ3MndsYWI2Mm05YmY3eGVoYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/CZO31ichBgaeZjaa5N/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]


Thanks for your support, we are looking forward to your feedback!

Your Team Pixelsplit

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

What a ride! We have reached 90% positive ratings here on STEAM. Thank you all for playing and all the kind words!

We have just released a patch to fix some issues.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] LiveSplit support for speedrunners
[/list]
[b]Improved[/b]
[list]
[*] "Grabbability" of collectible in act 4 [spoiler]flask in Desk[/spoiler]
[*] FOV for static cameras considers aspect ratio -> support for 32:9 screens
[*] Martha studio crouch hint shown only once.
[/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Train: After decoupling mouse couldn't be moved anymore
[*] Forest: Someone ran crazy in circles off the map
[*] Studio: Achievement "Flawless" triggered even if not played flawlessly.
[*] Boiler room: Some sound issues
[*] Save slot percentage in main menu didn't update properly after finishing the game
[*] Speech in apartment didn't play again
[*] Horse race machine in Dories room could break and stop progress
[*] Forest: Door to "nothing" could be opened in Dories room
[*] Forest: Round items had strange reflections
[*] Funhouse: Player could fall off map when walking back.
[/list]

If you have any feedback or just want to talk about REVEIL, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/SPQ7rQskpx]Discord[/url]!

- Your Team Pixelsplit

notes.title: Reveil is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

After five years of development, we're pleased to announce that REVEIL is being released today.

[previewyoutube=TMByypgipsY;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, the time has come, and you can immerse yourself in a world where the boundaries of reality and illusion are blurred.

Will you be able to guess the reason for Walter Thompson's mental state? 
The clues are everywhere, but will you be able to see them?

We are super excited about your gaming experience. Feel free to share your impressions and theories with us (for example in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/809060/discussions/]Steam discussion forum[/url]), but please refrain from spoiling the ending of the game.

We, the developers of REVEIL, have put a lot of thought, time and heart into this project and would like to thank everyone who has supported us during this time. Special thanks go out to our musicians who did an outstanding job on the soundtrack (listen to the REVEIL EP [url=https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/arinatara/reveil-original-soundtrack]here[/url]), to our publisher Daedalic Entertainment, who always stood by our side with help and advice, our beta testers who took the time to hunt down any bugs and give feedback and, of course, to our community, who always had our back during the development process.

By purchasing the Funhouse Edition, you are also directly supporting the musicians, as they receive a share of the proceeds. Take a look at what the Funhouse Edition contains:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32249742/fe3eba8a1f22d894a3313c98eba252ad64461ba9.jpg[/img]
Get REVEIL and the Funhouse Edition here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/809060/REVEIL/

If you have any questions, maybe because you are stuck with a puzzle or have any technical problems, please contact us at any time on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/jaegJK9GSt]Discord channel[/url] and we will be happy to help you.

Your Team Pixelsplit

Playstation: [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008839]Click Here[/url]

There is also more info on the Funhouse Edition, which is available here on STEAM as well as PlayStation and Xbox:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32249742/fe3eba8a1f22d894a3313c98eba252ad64461ba9.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] REVEIL Original Soundtrack: 14 original compositions, beautiful and haunting.

[*] Developer Commentary: Commentary by the developers to be found in-game, for even more background insights.
[/list]
Thank you so much for your support,
your team pixelsplit & Daedalic Entertainment

notes.title: Release Date & Pre-Order Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

we’re incredibly excited to announce our official release date.

REVEIL will launch on STEAM [b]March 6th 2024[/b]!

Take a trip into Walter Thompson's shattered psyche and immerse yourself in a wonderfully dark, twisted world where nothing is as it seems.
Become part of an incredible story in which you are confronted with challenging puzzles, contradictory clues and beautifully surreal environments. 

If you want to celebrate this news with us, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/809060/REVEIL/]pre-order REVEIL now[/url]!

Also, our new story trailer will be released on Youtube next Mondy. 
Activate notifications now and join the premiere!

[previewyoutube=xVCSoSNaXTE;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for your support,
your team pixelsplit
